title: State Compliance Bulletin: Drought Surcharge on Final Water Overage
content:
# Drought Surcharge — Utility Services Program, All-Inclusive Utility Package Final Water Overage

**Bulletin clause.** A drought surcharge multiple set by the community's state as recorded on the Apartment Home Lease applies to the final water overage line of an All-Inclusive Utility Package account:

| State recorded on the lease | Drought surcharge multiple |
|---|---|
| AZ | 1.10 |
| TX | 1.10 |
| CA | 1.05 |
| CO, WA, GA or any other state | none |

The multiple multiplies the line's charge; the charge is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

*Worked case (hypothetical charge before the surcharge of $31.50):* AZ or TX, $34.65; CA, $33.075, which is $33.08 at the end; WA, $31.50.
